notes.title: DevLog Update #1
notes.content:
Welcome to DevLog #1 Update!

Bug Fixes and Changes:

 Default DirectX Version reduced from 12 to 11.
 Changes have been made to Unreal Engine file packaging.
 Fixed the Pause Menu not opening when pressing the ESC key.
 Minor interface fixes have been made.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665226/15133f60fb2566e52d17f052b58b46f27b2130b0.jpg


New Features:

 First Person View Added.
 Top View Added.
